name: Solid Voxelization based on Octree
definition: A voxelization technique that constructs an octree representation of a mesh (OBJ files only) to determine solid/empty status and distance to surface for each leaf node, using ray casting for sign determination and closest-point distance for leaf nodes.
summary: Solid Voxelization based on Octree converts triangular meshes into adaptive solid voxel representations, distinguishing itself by using ray casting for sign determination rather than exact geometric intersection.
